exposure: 0.5% ropivacaine for quadratus lumborum muscle nerve block
0.25% ropivacaine for quadratus lumborum muscle nerve block
cohort: 60 elderly patients who underwent hip replacement surgery in a hospital between April and December 2019.
finding: The 0.25% ropivacaine method showed distinctive advantages over 0.50% ropivacaine psoas nerve anesthesia in elderly patients undergoing hip replacement surgery, despite having a slower onset of sensory and motor block but a significantly shorter recovery time.
